brief.question: How does Moises.app separate a song into individual stems (vocals, drums, bass, guitar...)? Where does the separation happen (on the computer or on their servers) and what is the flow?
brief.purpose: Learning, to inform the user's own stem separation app (do not clone)
constraints: Static only, do not run the target
Do not copy Moises artwork, fonts or markup

findings.statement: Moises.app 2.1.0 (Mac) does not split songs on the computer: its Resources folder holds no AI model files, only an Electron app (app.asar), an audio capture add-on (capture.node) and a plugin server helper. Its main code opens Moises's website https://studio.moises.ai inside the window, and the Play tab's 'new project' button points to the web page /upload/split/3.

Stem separation for Play happens on Moises's servers: the song is uploaded through the hosted web page and the stems come back from the server. The AI method used there cannot be seen from the desktop app.
